title: processAot fails with 'Failed to determine a suitable driver class' creating the jdbcDialect bean (Spring Data JDBC + AOT)

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: The Gradle processAot task fails with AotProcessingException in BeanRegistrationsAotProcessor: Error creating bean with name 'jdbcDialect' ... DataSourceBeanCreationException: Failed to determine a suitable driver class. Tests and bootRun with datasource settings from environment variables work fine.
cause: During AOT processing Spring Data JDBC creates the JdbcDialect bean by initializing the DataSource and NamedParameterJdbcTemplate and detecting the dialect from a live database connection. At build time there are no spring.datasource.* settings and no database, so the datasource cannot be created. This is by design; the Boot issue was closed as a documentation item.
fixSummary: Define the dialect yourself so no database access is needed during AOT processing, e.g. a @Bean returning JdbcPostgresDialect.INSTANCE typed as JdbcDialect (use the matching dialect for other databases). Setting the spring.data.jdbc.dialect property does not avoid the failure. Supplying a live database at build time also works but is usually undesirable.
